parent_objective: run M1438 row-level forward geometry source miner on M1443 selected enriched rows
blocked_by: M1444 promotes to forward source preflight validation and admits row-level miner smoke
supersedes: running row-level miner on stale M1425 pressure rows

public_gates: M1445 must run M1438 row-level forward geometry source miner only
M1445 must not run source preflight bounded replay outcome interventions train PPO promote use private holdout export corpus or change actor inputs
M1445 must report forward geometry source rows and selected candidate rows
forbidden_shortcuts: do not use M1425 reveal-step pressure metrics as source-step action evidence

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs row-level forward relocation proposal miner on M1443 enriched rows before source preflight
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: row-level source miner smoke only; no source preflight, replay, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if row-level miner produces zero selected candidate rows
stop if relocation clipping dominates selected rows
stop if selected diversity collapses to one seed or one variant
stop if run requires actor input changes or stale M1425 metric reuse
fallback_plan: route to result audit if row-level miner gates fail
route to geometry-aware source preflight smoke if row-level miner passes
route to branch synthesis if another missing layer appears

training_stage.stage_objective: row-level forward geometry source miner smoke
admission_evidence: M1438 implements row-level forward geometry source miner
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up preflight smoke or audit manifest
next_stage_criteria: forward geometry source rows are nonzero

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1445 row-level source mining does not prove history necessity because it still precedes outcome replay.
history_necessity_tests: future source preflight and bounded replay must test whether selected history variants affect outcomes
row-level geometry/action selection cannot count as actual history-positive replay evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If selected candidate rows are zero, route to audit rather than lowering source geometry gates or claiming no-history evidence.
allowed_claims: row-level source miner counts and geometry/diversity summaries
no replay result, promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1443 selected enriched rows can pass the M1438 row-level forward geometry source miner and produce selected relocation candidates for a later preflight smoke.
success_criteria: forward geometry source rows are nonzero
no source preflight replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: forward geometry source rows are zero
run starts source preflight replay training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export or actor-input change
decision_rule: M1445 passes if row-level forward geometry miner produces nonzero selected relocation candidates without running preflight or replay.
